name: Hospis Malaysia
summary: Provides free home-based palliative care to people with life-limiting illness and their families, and trains health workers and campaigns to make palliative care widely available in Malaysia.
programmes: After-hours and phone support for patients and families
Training for doctors, nurses and medical students
Advocacy for national palliative care policy
Loan of medical equipment (beds, oxygen concentrators, syringe drivers)
impact: Around 800 healthcare workers and medical students trained each year (site, 2026)
beneficiaries: Patients with life-limiting illnesses and their families, mainly in the Klang Valley

organisation.leadership: Dato' Kathleen Chew Wai Lin (Chairman); Irvin Menezes (Treasurer); Lim Wai Yee (Secretary); Prof Dr Khoo Ee Ming (Council Member); Ehon Chan Yee Hon (Council Member)
organisation.accounts: No audited financial statements public; 5-Year Review 2017-2021: https://hospismalaysia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Hospis-Malaysia-5-Year-Review-2017-2021.pdf (list at https://hospismalaysia.org/reports/)

live.note: YouTube channel linked from site (https://www.youtube.com/c/HospisMalaysiaOfficial); video count and live streaming not verified
